theoremCandidate: If attacker owns the four pair residuals {x,h},{h,y},{u,h+},{h+,v}, h+ is immediately above h in one column, h is playable or one support event away, attacker moves, and no defender counterwin exists after the support move, then attacker can force terminal or at least one live singleton residual in at most three plies.
